correctness.rationale: The Fock monomial basis e_j=(pi^j/j!)^1/2*z^j diagonalizes the disk localization operator with lambda_j=integral_0^s t^j e^-t/j!dt and gap lambda_j-lambda_{j+1}=p_{j+1}>0. Moving radial boundary s+epsilon*h(theta) is twice trace-norm differentiable for s>0. Direct differentiations give M_jk_prime=sqrt(p_j p_k) hhat_{k-j} and M_jj_double=p_j(j/s-1)*mean(h^2). Isolated-cluster eigenvalue perturbation cancels internal-block terms; cross-gap terms sum with denominators sum_{r=j+1}^{j+m}p_r. Telescoping sum_{j<N}p_j(j/s-1)=-p_{N-1}, and Parseval for real mean-zero h, yield exactly sum_{m>=1}kappa_{N,m}|hhat_m|^2 deficit. m=1 cancels, m=2 gives positive p_{N-1}(N+2s+1)/[(N+s)(N+s+1)] including N=1; high m limit p_{N-1}. Abreu global inequality forces nonnegativity, not the actual formula. Independent Fraction checks of 21 (N,s) pairs validate these exact identities; smooth fixed-parameter perturbation proof is essential.
